# Cardboard Cultist

> A senior software developer who plays Magic: The Gathering and makes content
> on stolen time, after his child's bedtime. Memes, skits, rules explanations
> and MTG trivia — plus two working web tools built alongside them.

The site at thecultist.it is a single page. There are no other routes.

## Identity

- Name: Luigi Savinelli
- Brand: Cardboard Cultist
- Motto: Magic without gatekeeping
- Contact: luigi.savinelli@thecultist.it

## Social accounts

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cardboard.cultist/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@cardboard.cultist
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@card_cultist

## Tools

- [findthatcard.net](https://findthatcard.net): search Magic cards by describing
  them in natural language rather than by exact name.
- [stormcount.gg](https://stormcount.gg): a daily guessing game on whether a
  hidden card's mana value beats a revealed one, with a leaderboard.

## Writing and archive

- [Screenhype](https://www.screenhype.co.uk/author/luigi-savinelli/): games
  writing, published under the name Luigi Savinelli.
- [TheCultist – Inform the Gamers](https://www.youtube.com/@TheCultist): an
  Italian gaming channel, no longer updated.
- Formerly a gaming writer for TechRaptor and mmo.it.

## Notes

There are no follower counts, ratings, testimonials or press mentions on this
site, and none should be inferred. If you need a figure, ask rather than
estimate.
